organizations.overview: A community food pantry operated out of Haitian Emmanuel Baptist Church at 7321 NE 2nd Ave, Miami, FL 33138 — the same zip code as this address — providing emergency food assistance to low-income families, seniors, and the unemployed.

plannedActivities.text: Runs a weekly food distribution every Thursday at 12:00 PM, serving low-income families, seniors, disabled veterans, and the working poor in the immediate area.

reviewNotes: Weakest sourcing of the four topics — the only citation is a directory listing, not a news article or the church's own site, so the underlying facts (hours, exact scope) are thinner than the other three drafts. Locality is genuinely hyperlocal (same zip, a specific street address, walkable distance), but this one needs a second, stronger source before it should be trusted at the same level as the historic-preservation or racial-justice findings — a good example of why locality and source quality are separate things to grade.
